findings.title: Attempt idempotency key conflicts with the multi-method attempt lifecycle
findings.statement: observation-authority.md makes each permit name exactly one method (lines 50-52), says the same attemptId with changed bytes/mode/METHOD/parent is ERR[OBSERVATION_ATTEMPT_COLLISION] (line 80; failure example K2-ATTEMPT_DUPLICATE_BODY_CHANGE: 'different body or method'), yet one attempt's durable substeps span challenge issuance AND ExecCreate/Start (lines 87-89), and an UNKNOWN attempt may only be settled by RECONCILE_OWNED_ATTEMPT on that same attempt (lines 105-111). A new attempt is refused while the prior one is not terminal (line 81) or UNKNOWN (line 83).
findings.counterexample: A1: CHALLENGE_ISSUE succeeds (challenge issued, no Exec). Request OBSERVER_EXEC_CREATE_START for A1 -> method differs -> COLLISION. Request new A2 -> A1 not terminal -> NOT_TERMINAL. No conforming request can complete the observation. Same for UNKNOWN: RECONCILE_OWNED_ATTEMPT(A1) -> COLLISION; new attempt -> OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; the ambiguity can never be reconciled, or an implementer silently re-keys idempotency (a hidden design choice).
alsoUnspecified: Allowed method order/state transitions per attempt (which method is legal from which recorded state, e.g. RECONCILE only from INTENT_COMMITTED/UNKNOWN, CHALLENGE_REPLACE only as the creation of a new attempt)
Disposition when the permit/parent window expires after ExecCreate but before ExecStart (must stay INTENT_COMMITTED/reconcile, never REFUSED_NO_EFFECT)
Slot/key for TERMINAL_NORMAL3_OBSERVE: the one-slot table is keyed by K1 parentOperationId, which a normal:3 lease is not
findings.requiredRevision: Separate the immutable attempt body (mode, typed parent, scope, head/seal, observer identities) from per-step permits; define the idempotency key as (attemptId, method, step/permit id) with exact same-bytes replay per step; give a closed per-attempt state machine with legal method transitions and the refusal for each illegal one; add red/green examples for challenge->exec progression, reconcile-of-UNKNOWN, permit expiry between create and start, and normal-mode keying. Root choice already covers the policy; this is owner contract correction, then separate actual review.
